title: Grateful Dead Live at Deer Creek Music Center on 1990-07-19
lineage: Master Cassettes (Maxell MX 100) Tascam 112MKII -> Korg MR-1, 1bit 2.8MHz -> USB -> Korg Audio Gate Software 24bit 96KHz -> Wave Lab 6.0 w/UAD -> R8brain for 16bit 44.1KHz sample rate conversion -> Traders Little Helper flac8 -> Tagged w/Tag & Rename
source: (FOB Sec B Row 17 DFC) Nakamichi CM-100's with CP-1 caps -> Sony WM-D6

ai_review.summary: Tinny but lively audience tape that captures a stellar first set and a weaker second set.
ai_review.review: The metal‑cassette source is surprisingly clear after a solid transfer, with nice levels and an enjoyable crowd ambience despite some tinny and slightly muddled Phil bass. Fans rave about the first set being one of the best of ’90, though the second set is generally regarded as a letdown.

ai_rating.rationale: Show quality is split – high praise for the first set but criticism of the second – while the recording, though tinny, is well‑transferred and enjoyable. Weighted average yields a solid mid‑range rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Levels are nice; metal cassette gives a slightly tinny character, Phil's bass a bit muddled, but the transfer and cleanup are strong and crowd noise adds atmosphere.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set praised as one of the best of the era; second set considered weak, creating an uneven overall experience.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Positive mention – "jerry is rockin" indicates strong guitar work.
band_member_comments.Phil: Slightly muddled bass noted by reviewer.
